description: Conformance battery for `aval relevant`. Each case names a corpus under corpora/,
a query, and what the ranking must say. The harness rules are `resolve.json`'s:
`name` is the test name, an unknown field in `expected` throws rather than being
skipped, and `min_cases` keeps an empty or mis-parsed file from passing green.
Two properties are asserted here that no other battery can reach.
DETERMINISM. The harness runs every case TWICE and compares the whole payload
byte for byte. A ranking is a pure function of the corpus and the query
(SEMANTICS section 12), so a tokenizer that grew a rule, a stemmer that changed
its mind or a sort that fell back on directory order fails here rather than
silently reordering somebody's ranking six months later.
THE ANNOTATIONS. A ranked key carries the verdict `resolve` gives it, not one the
ranker invented: `undecided` stays undecided, `contradiction` stays a stop, and
both are flagged `unresolved` in `dependencies` for a router. That is the whole
reason relevance is allowed to exist alongside an exact resolver (section 5.1).
`paths` in a case name files that do NOT exist in this repository, on purpose:
the co-change signal reads `git log`, so a fixture path that existed here would
make the expected order depend on this repository's own history and stop being

query.text: where do we keep objects in buckets

cases.name: a_superseded_title_finds_the_key_and_the_head_answers_it
cases.why: Only the replaced record says `Garage` or `MinIO`. Retrieval reads it; the answer is still the head's.

cases.name: a_glob_in_a_record_matches_by_its_literal_directory
cases.why: `kubernetes/apps/*/values.yaml` in ADR-0002 covers the path; ci.system ranks below it on the word `forgejo` alone.

cases.name: a_key_decided_only_at_a_scope_is_undecided_at_the_default
cases.why: Undecided here is true and useless alone, so the ranking names the scope that does decide it — from the graph, not by inference.

cases.name: an_undecided_key_is_named_rather_than_invented
cases.why: The key is registered and nothing decided it. A ranking that dropped it would be the moment an agent invents one.

cases.name: a_contradiction_is_reported_and_flagged_unresolved
cases.why: Exit 5 means stop. A router reads `unresolved`, and a ranking that softened it would be teaching a caller to pick a side.

cases.name: a_retired_key_is_reported_as_retired

query.text: dynamic DNS record updater for the WAN address

cases.why: Retired is an answer with positive evidence behind it (section 6), so it is not an unresolved dependency.

cases.name: a_scoped_ranking_answers_at_that_scope
cases.why: ADR-0021 replaced ADR-0009 for this scope only, and the ranking answers with the replacement. The second row is the tail a ranking has — scored a quarter of the first — and it is asserted rather than trimmed, because a battery that only pinned the winner would not notice the tail moving.
